acceptanceCriteria.text: Explicit source scopes from a user demand are preserved through planning and DecompositionPlan units.
A low-conflict two-file demand with two non-overlapping accepted scopes can reach `ready-for-scheduler-contract`.
If planning/decomposition adds tests, indexes, docs, or other files outside the accepted constrained scopes, that expansion is recorded and scheduler readiness is blocked until accepted.
Missing, vague, overlapping, or dependency-linked source scopes do not reach scheduler-ready.
Workbench does not show bounded scheduler continuation / full-access scheduler path when scope expansion is unresolved.
Raw `planning.scheduler.*` actions remain outside the direct `完全访问权限` allowlist.
